bottleneck.description: Dominant ADAS vision SoC supplier with EyeQ family deployed in ~230M vehicles across ~1,200 vehicle models and >95% win rate at top OEM customers, creating multi-year automotive qualification switching cost.

dependency.key_customers: VW Group, Stellantis, GM, Ford, BMW, Audi, Nissan, Honda, Hyundai, Geely and most other global OEMs ex-Tesla
dependency.key_suppliers: STMicroelectronics (sole historical EyeQ SoC fabricator), TSMC (added for EyeQ6/imaging radar redundancy), Quanta Computer (ECU assembly)

editorial.notes: Mobileye is the closest analog to a structural ADAS oligopoly leader with auto-grade qualification creating prohibitive near-term switching cost (consistent with the ALGM/auto-MCU MEDIUM anchor). However, the broader ADAS-to-AD compute market is genuinely contested by Nvidia Drive (Mercedes, JLR, BYD wins), Qualcomm Snapdragon Ride (BMW, GM partial), Tesla in-house, Huawei MDC and Horizon Robotics in China — and Mobileye has been losing some China share. MEDIUM (not HIGH) reflects real switching cost on awarded programs but genuine multi-vendor competition for new design wins.
